Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating life insurance when an order regarding life sustaining treatment has been issued or implemented.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to life insurance when an order regarding lifesustaining treatment has been issued or implemented; adding a newsection to chapter 48.23 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 48.24RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The issuing or implementation of a physician order for lifesustaining treatment does not restrict, inhibit, or impair in anymanner the sale, procurement, or issuance of any policy of lifeinsurance, nor does it modify the terms of an existing policy of lifeinsurance, notwithstanding any term of the policy to the contrary. (2) For the purposes of this section "physician order for lifesustaining treatment" means a document, commonly referred to as a donot resuscitate order, that is signed by a physician, summarizing thewishes of an individual regarding life-sustaining treatment throughspecific medical orders including an individual's preference forresuscitation, medical intervention, use of antibiotics, andartificially administered fluids and nutrition.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Section 1 of this act applies to group life insurance policiesregulated under this chapter.
